description: Implement voice recording with expo-av, OpenAI Whisper API integration for speech-to-text, tajweed analysis logic, and progress tracking with AsyncStorage persistence
steps: Create src/services/audioRecorder.ts - wrapper around expo-av Audio.Recording with methods: startRecording (request permissions, configure high quality m4a recording, start), stopRecording (stop and get URI), getRecordingStatus (duration, isRecording). Use Audio.RecordingOptionsPresets.HIGH_QUALITY.

Create src/services/whisperApi.ts - OpenAI Whisper API integration: transcribeAudio function that takes audio file URI and API key, creates multipart/form-data with the audio file, model='whisper-1', language='ar', sends POST to https://api.openai.com/v1/audio/transcriptions, returns transcription text. Handle errors gracefully.

Create src/services/tajweedAnalyzer.ts - analyzes transcription against expected text: compareTexts function that takes expected Arabic text and transcribed text, calculates similarity score (0-100), identifies specific errors/mismatches, returns TajweedAnalysisResult with score, errors array (with position and type), and suggestions. Include Arabic text normalization (remove tashkeel for comparison).

Create src/contexts/ProgressContext.tsx - React Context for progress state: loads UserProgress array from AsyncStorage on mount, provides methods to updateProgress(ruleId, score), markLessonComplete(ruleId), getProgressForRule(ruleId), getOverallScore(), getWeeklyActivity(), getStreak(). Persists all changes to AsyncStorage.

Create src/contexts/RecordingContext.tsx - React Context for recording state: manages current recording session, stores RecordingResult array in AsyncStorage, provides startSession, endSession, saveResult methods

Update PracticeSessionScreen to wire up recording flow: tap record -> audioRecorder.startRecording -> tap stop -> audioRecorder.stopRecording -> whisperApi.transcribeAudio -> tajweedAnalyzer.compareTexts -> display score and errors -> save to progress
Update RecordingScreen to use the recording service for general ayah recording
Update ProgressScreen to read real data from ProgressContext (overall score, weekly activity, per-rule stats)
acceptance_criteria: src/services/audioRecorder.ts exports startRecording, stopRecording, getRecordingStatus functions using expo-av
src/services/whisperApi.ts exports transcribeAudio function that properly constructs multipart request to OpenAI API
src/services/tajweedAnalyzer.ts exports compareTexts function with Arabic normalization and scoring logic
src/contexts/ProgressContext.tsx provides full progress tracking with AsyncStorage persistence
src/contexts/RecordingContext.tsx manages recording sessions and results
PracticeSessionScreen has complete recording -> transcription -> analysis -> feedback flow
ProgressScreen shows real progress data from context
All API calls handle errors gracefully with user-friendly messages in Uzbek
verification: Verify audioRecorder.ts imports from expo-av and uses Audio.Recording API correctly
Verify whisperApi.ts constructs proper FormData with file, model, and language fields
Verify tajweedAnalyzer.ts includes Arabic text normalization (tashkeel removal regex)
Verify ProgressContext reads from and writes to AsyncStorage
Verify PracticeSessionScreen connects recording -> API -> analysis -> display flow
